headline: Niger Receives 1.65 Million Liters of Algerian Fuel Amid Shortages
summary: Niger received its first shipment of fuel from Algeria, with 53 tanker trucks delivering 1.65 million liters of petroleum products to Agadez under military escort to ease persistent shortages.
why: Cross-border energy cooperation and fuel logistics are vital for stabilizing supply chains and industrial operations in nations experiencing fuel shortages.

impacts.name: Niger
impacts.why: Fuel deliveries help alleviate domestic energy shortages.
